references.text: The Israelites camped on the plains of Moab by the Jordan, across from Jericho—the same place mentioned in the travel route.
Moses and Eleazar spoke to the people on the plains of Moab by the Jordan, at Jericho.
The plains of Moab by the Jordan, at Jericho, are mentioned as the place where the plunder from the Midianite war was brought.
The previous stop in the travel route—they departed from the mountains of Abarim, which are mentioned here.
The Lord spoke to Moses on the plains of Moab by the Jordan, at Jericho—the same location.
The commands and laws were given on the plains of Moab by the Jordan, at Jericho.
Moses went up Mount Nebo in the Abarim range opposite Jericho, which connects the mountains of Abarim with the plains of Moab.
Moses died in the land of Moab, in the area where the Israelites had camped.
The Israelites departed from Shittim and came to the Jordan before crossing over to Jericho—continuing their journey from the plains of Moab.
